description_en: Queries the encryption status and detection results of columns
description_zh: 查询列加密状态和识别结果
name: ListDataMaskingColumns

parameters.help_en:
The column encryption status filter. Valid values:
NotEncrypted: Not encrypted.
Success: Encryption succeeded.
Failed: Encryption failed
parameters.help_zh: 列加密状态筛选。NotEncrypted：未加密；Success：加密成功；Failed：加密失败
parameters.name: masking_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain this value from Items[].Id in the response of the ListTemplates operation. This value must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and detection model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a sensitivity level. You can obtain this value from the ListRiskLevels operation. The uppercase L in the parameter name must be preserved
parameters.help_zh: 单个敏感等级标识，可从 ListRiskLevels 获取。参数名中的大写 L 应保留
parameters.name: risk_leve_l_id

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the database. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The table name. For PostgreSQL or Oracle scenarios, preserve the schema.table format obtained from the table list
parameters.help_zh: 数据表名称。PostgreSQL 或 Oracle 场景应保留从表列表取得的 schema.table 形式
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current query. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The cloud product type ID. Valid values:
5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

This value must correspond to ProductCode if both are specified
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The list of sensitivity level IDs, separated by commas. Select values from the ListRiskLevels response that corresponds to the same TemplateId
parameters.help_zh: 敏感等级标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔；从同一 TemplateId 对应的 ListRiskLevels 返回值中选择
parameters.name: risk_level_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of detection model IDs, separated by commas. Select values from the ListIdentifyModels response that corresponds to the same TemplateId
parameters.help_zh: 识别模型标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔；从同一 TemplateId 对应的 ListIdentifyModels 返回值中选择
parameters.name: template_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The compatible product ID list parameter. For column queries, use a single ProductId or ProductCode. Call the operation separately for each product when querying multiple products
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的产品标识列表参数。当前列查询请使用单个 ProductId 或 ProductCode；查询多个产品时分别调用
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. This value must match the EngineType of the target instance, for example, MySQL or PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型，应与目标实例的 EngineType 一致，例如 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two values must correspond
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the current query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

DataType.description_en: The data type of the database column

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code of the record or operation. This value can be empty if no error occurs. Evaluate this value together with ErrorMessage
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误码。无错误时可为空；应结合 ErrorMessage 判断

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error description of the record or operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误说明

Id.description_en: The ID of the column record

InstanceId.description_en: The instance identity of the database

MaskingStatus.description_en:
The column encryption status. Valid values:
NotEncrypted: Not encrypted.
Processing: Being processed.
Success: Encryption succeeded.
Failed: Encryption failed.
Deleting: Being disabled.
DeleteFailed: Disabling failed
MaskingStatus.description_zh: 列加密状态。NotEncrypted：未加密；Processing：处理中；Success：加密成功；Failed：加密失败；Deleting：关闭中；DeleteFailed：关闭失败

ModelTags.description_en: The list of matched model tags

Id.description_en: The ID of the model tag

Name.description_en: The name of the model tag
The name of the data column

ProductId.description_en:
The cloud product type ID. Valid values:
5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the asset

RiskLevelId.description_en: The ID of the sensitivity level

RiskLevelName.description_en: The name of the sensitivity level

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the matched detection rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the matched detection rule

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page for the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
